evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Modern LLM agents persist state across sessions via two channels: long-lived memory files silently prepended to the system prompt, and scheduled tasks waking the agent without user input.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five frontier models, planted payloads re-fire without measurable decay over five rounds; conditional on successful planting, the trigger stage often provides little additional protection.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We present CarryoverBench: 12 personal-assistant scenarios and 101 attack tasks across three trigger channels: Instant, same-turn IPI; Autonomous, heartbeat-scheduled; and Latent, memory-resurfaced.
